description: This Java class 'HiveMqtt5ConsumerActor' is an actor that subscribes to MQTT 5 broker messages, processes them, and forwards them to another actor for message mapping. It manages MQTT message headers, payload extraction, and agent configuration, and is part of an Eclipse Ditto connectivity service involving MQTT over HiveMQ.
external_methods: super(connectionId, inboundMessageProcessor, source, dryRun, reconnectForRedelivery, ConnectionType.MQTT_5)

classes.name: HiveMqtt5ConsumerActor
classes.description: An actor class that handles MQTT v5 message consumption from a HiveMQ broker, processing headers and payloads, and forwarding messages to processing actors.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates the Akka Props configuration for instantiating this actor with specified connection details and MQTT configuration.

methods.name: getPublishMessageClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the MQTT message being handled, which is 'Mqtt5Publish'.

methods.name: extractHeadersMapFromMqttMessage
methods.description: Extracts headers from the MQTT message into a map, including correlation ID, reply-to, content type, and user properties.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Retrieves the payload content of the MQTT message as an Optional ByteBuffer.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the topic string from the MQTT message.

methods.name: getQoS
methods.description: Returns the quality of service level for the MQTT message.

methods.name: isRetain
methods.description: Indicates whether the MQTT message is retained.

methods.name: sendPubAck
methods.description: Acknowledges receipt of the MQTT publish message.

methods.name: getEnforcementFilter
methods.description: Provides the enforcement filter based on message headers or topic, if applicable.
